Eli: Heads-up: planning a focused sprint for 'Optimize Advisor' — goal is recommendations (batching, prefix cache, quant profiles) + eval-triggered alerts. Want to lock MVP scope and launch gates. Quick takes?

Marta: Lean MVP: 1) per-route batching suggestions, 2) prefix-KV cache candidates with hit-rate estimate, 3) conservative quant profiles (int8/ltq) with predicted quality delta, 4) eval alerts that surface failing examples and a triage bundle. No auto-apply.

Jon: Customers: VertexLabs wants CSV export of examples for audits; MedLedger requires opt-in and explicit approval before any apply. Dedicated installs need ticketed apply workflow.

Priya: Acceptance criteria: recommendations concordance >=88% vs SME on curated prompt sets; expected quality delta for quant <=2.0% on core sets; p50 latency change when applied <=8%. Alerts: attach 30 failing examples + model metadata.

Sam: UX/API: Console card shows estimated monthly savings, p50 latency delta, confidence score, and "request apply" for dedicated accounts. API returns a recommendations array and a privacy_consent flag.

Eli: Privacy: no raw prompts in outbound payloads unless tenant telemetry_consent=true. Triage bundle export blocked until privacy review done.

Marta: Launch checklist: (alpha) 1) 2 pilot customers (hosted + dedicated), 2) docs + opt-in toggle in Console, 3) E2E tests for batching/cache/quant, 4) eval harness + baseline prompt sets, 5) runbook + rollback steps, 6) privacy sign-off for any export.

Jon: I'll own ops/ticket flow and the dedicated apply stub. Priya -> eval harness + thresholds. Marta -> console UI and savings calc. Eli -> PM + pilot outreach. Sam -> API schema. Target alpha in 3 weeks.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advisor/alpha -> staging at 3309998918 by @ci-bot

Eli: Cool. I'll summarize this into a short spec and ping pilot contacts. If any blockers, drop them here. :rocket:
